counterQr.title: The code on your counter
counterQr.body: A customer without a card scans the QR on your lobby screen. Their card lands straight in their phone wallet, no app to download.

scanning.title: Scanning a customer
scanning.body: Tap Scan, then point the camera at the card in the customer's wallet. That's the whole job.

stamp.title: Adding stamps
stamp.body: One tap adds one stamp. Bought a round? Use the stepper to add several at once. When the card fills up, the reward appears and you hand it over.

points.title: Adding points
points.body: Type the ticket amount on the keypad and the points work themselves out. To give a reward, pick it from the rewards list instead.

locations.title: Choosing your venue
locations.body: You work in more than one place, so pick the right one at the top of the lobby before you scan. Every scan is credited there.
